rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not look up the order with the provided tools, did not provide the arrival/shipping status, and did not follow the requested conditional cancellation and refund logic. It also made an unsupported statement that the order will remain active without verifying anything. No confirmation was sought for any order-changing action. This violates the policy requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders, confirm before writes, and provide correct, tool-supported information.
